title.narrative: Promoting a more Equitable, Sustainable and Safer Education

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve the Ministry of Education's planning functions and support access to primary education with improved learning conditions

The development objective of the Promoting an Efficient Education System in Haiti is to improve the ministry of education's planning and regulatory functions and the learning assessment system. The project comprises of three components. The first component, improving planning and regulation aims at strengthening the management of the education sector. It consists of following sub-components: (i) strengthening planning capacity; (ii) strengthening departmental directorate of education (DDEs) planning capacity; and (iii) supporting regulatory capacity. The second component, improving the learning assessment system will aim at strengthening the management of the education sector by supporting the improvement of the learning assessment system at the centralized level and the decentralized level. It consists of following sub-components: (i) improving the learning assessment system at the central level; and (ii) improving the learning assessment system at the decentralized level. The third component, project management, monitoring and evaluation will provide support to ministry of national education and vocational training (MENFP) for project implementation, monitoring, and evaluation.

title.narrative: IRI11. Public school classrooms repaired, rehabilitated, rebuilt or newly built

comment.narrative: Rehabilitations of 3 additional schools are expected to be completed by the end of February 2026 and 5 additional schools by June 2026. These 8 schools are expected to add 63 rehabilitated, rebuilt or newly built classrooms. The launch of the last batch of 7 schools for rehabilitations (which would add 72 classrooms) has been delayed by the impacts of hurricane Melissa.

IRI1. Efficient new data collection implemented

baseline.value: DDE staff trained on data collection (using former protocol)

target.value: A statistical report for each DDE is available

actual.value: A model report for DDE level using new EMIS data collected in 2023-24 has been developed. The 10 DDE-level reports are being prepared.

title.narrative: PDOI1. The EMIS is used to improve planning and decision-making

baseline.value: Data collection strategy to be updated

target.value: EMIS data is used for planning and decision-making (allocation of at least two sets of resources is informed by data from the EMIS, including one based on sex-disaggregated data).

comment.narrative: New EMIS data has been used to implement the school accreditation policy; identify beneficiary student families for cash transfers; identify new beneficiary schools for education projects; and identify gender parity gaps in school enrollment and develop a conditional tuition subsidy program in private schools in targeted areas to reduce such gaps.

actual.value: New EMIS data collected in 2023-24, including sex-disaggregated data, has been used for planning and decision-making on several sets of resources.

title.narrative: IRI4. Learning assessments plan is developed and implemented

baseline.value: Learning assessment system diagnostic has been prepared and is pending validation

target.value: National learning levels are determined and disseminated for at least one grade in primary education, with focus on mother tongue, as part of implementation of learning assessment plan.

actual.value: A technical plan related to learning assessments has been prepared. Analysis of existing learning assessment data to determine learning levels has been planned.

title.narrative: IR10. Development of a school infrastructure investment plan

target.value: Draft school infrastructure investment plan available

comment.narrative: The school infrastructure investment plan is under preparation, with the team of experts getting completed and with strengthened coordination among stakeholders.

actual.value: An updated work plan is available.

title.narrative: IR7. Teachers in Project-supported public and non-public schools trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1-2

baseline.value: Public and non-public schools don't have set of textbooks in mother tongue.

target.value: 90% of teachers in Project-supported schools are trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1-2.

actual.value: 63% of teachers in project-supported schools in the Grand Sud have been trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1 and 2.

title.narrative: IRI8. School directors in Project-supported public and non-public schools trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1-2

baseline.value: Public and non-public schools don't have set of textbooks in mother tongue.

target.value: 90% of school directors in Project-supported schools are trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1-2.

actual.value: 70% of school directors in project-supported schools in the Grand Sud have been trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1 and 2.

title.narrative: IRI2. Mother tongue instruction is promoted in grades 1 and 2

baseline.value: Set of textbooks of all subjects in mother tongue is not available.

target.value: Teachers in 80% of non-public schools in the zones covered by pedagogical advisors in the 10 departments are trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1 and 2.

actual.value: Teachers in 81% of public schools covered by pedagogical advisors in 10 departments have been trained on the use of new textbooks in mother tongue in grades 1 and 2. Training for non-public school teachers is ongoing.

title.narrative: PDOI2. The school accreditation policy is implemented.

baseline.value: Standards for school quality are revised based on QAS data

target.value: Licenses to operate are issued to 80% of non-public schools identified in the EMIS, and the accreditation process is digitized

actual.value: About 50% of the identified nonpublic schools have received a license to operate. The digitization of the accreditation process is being planned.

title.narrative: IRI1.a. Gender. Implementation of a student database in the EMIS, disaggregated by age, school year and sex

target.value: Publication of annual statistics on students using the EMIS student database

actual.value: Student-level statistics based on new EMIS data have been published.

title.narrative: IRI3. Pedagogical practices are supported in public schools.

baseline.value: The departments have existing classroom observation tools.

target.value: Improved classroom observation tools are used in training for school inspectors and school directors in the 10 departments for pedagogical supervision.

actual.value: A report on Teach Primary data collected by pedagogical advisors in 10 departments has been prepared. Inspector and school director training on Teach Primary is ongoing.

title.narrative: IRI4. Variable Part Indicator - Improving schools quality through better supervision and support

baseline.value: DDE staff trained on school supervision and planning

target.value: School improvement plans implemented in 80% of the targeted public schools

comment.narrative: This Variable Part indicator has been removed per the last restructuring. It remains here due to a portal issue and will be removed at the next additional financing planned for Q2 of FY26.

actual.value: Data on pedagogical practices in the classroom are being collected in public and non-public schools nationally to inform supervision and support to improve teaching and learning quality in school.

title.narrative: IRI3. Variable Part Indicator - Equity strengthened through the implementation of programs targeting priority groups

baseline.value: DDE staff trained to target equity gaps

target.value: Equity gap reduction in at least 80% of suppported schools

comment.narrative: This Variable Part indicator has been removed per the last restructuring. It remains here due to a portal issue and will be removed at the next additional financing planned for Q2 of FY26.

actual.value: Activities are underway nationally to enhance equity in learning through promotion of mother tongue instruction in early grades.
